answer: A forged identity must replicate the full bond plus attestation history, so creating N fakes costs N times the stake and compute. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bonded stake to register, and peers attest liveness by challenging it to solve a fresh puzzle whose answer is hashed into an on-chain crystal record. Duplicates show as an ivory ledger entry lacking a matching mirror hash from independent peers, and slashing burns the bond, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
